create_denoising_dataset: create a DenoisingDataset instance wrapping a TokenBlockDataset with mask ratio and whole word masking config
collate_samples: collate a list of source-target sample dicts into a padded mini-batch tensor dict for BART training
add_whole_word_mask: add whole word masking noise to a source token tensor with configurable span and random replacement
add_insertion_noise: add insertion noise tokens to a source tensor at random positions with mask or random token values
permute_sentences: permute sentence order in a source token tensor by detecting full stops and swapping sentence positions
